name: Satoru
source:
Even before he was old enough to masturbate, Satoru would wear his older sister's clothing in secret. Ever since she found him out, Satoru has been undergoing feminization training.

After the death of his sister, Satoru was taken in by a female doctor, and met Mio through these events.
